cho-a.hint: A slow clock shows less than the real time. A fast clock shows more. Both clocks should give the same real time.

cho-b.hint: Work out the envelope labelled WORKSHOP first. It can't hold what its label says, and the spa key is already taken.

rigsby-a.hint: 777 means key 7 tapped three times, so the third letter on key 7.

van-pelt-a.hint: Each group is line–word–letter. 2-1-1 means line 2, word 1, letter 1.

van-pelt-b.hint: Write each reading as a sum of powers of two (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128). Each power is one zone.

lisbon-a.hint: strcmp returns 0 when the two strings are the same.

lisbon-b.hint: 943 / 100 is 9 in integer division, and 943 % 100 is 43.
